title: Rainy day workout: do these 4 every day this week at home
caption: Rainy day workout at home: four moves, about ten minutes, nothing to buy. Wall Push-Up, Doorframe Row, Glute Bridge and Knee Plank, all quiet and all indoors. Save this for the rainy week.

overlays.text: Do these 4 every day this week, even when it rains.

scenes.footer: Push. The wall by the rainy window.

overlays.text: Wall Push-Up. 10 reps. Hands on the wall, lower slow, press yourself away.

scenes.footer: Pull. Any doorframe in the house.

overlays.text: Doorframe Row. 8 reps. Hold the frame, lean back, pull your chest to the door.
Glute Bridge. 10 reps. Lie on your back, feet flat, lift your hips, lower slow.

scenes.footer: Core. Hold it and listen to the rain.

overlays.text: Knee Plank. 25 seconds. Forearms and knees down, body in one line, breathe.

scenes.footer: Push, pull, hinge, core. Four patterns, four moves.

overlays.text: No squat this week. It comes back next week, with a wall and a chair.

scenes.footer: Ten minutes is complete, rain or shine.

overlays.text: Three rounds of the four. About ten minutes, and you never leave the house.

scenes.footer: Save this for the rainy week.

overlays.text: Which room are you training in today?
